tg_bath_attendant: Pumps run off the harbour, so I know the water before the pilots do.
It has come in warm all month. Warm and very still.
My mother worked these pools forty years. She never once saw warm in spring.
tg_bath_soaker: Eleven hours on the east mole and every hour of it lifting for one charter.
Crates that do not rattle. That is the thing. Nothing in them moves.
You get a feel for what a crate has in it. Those ones have machine in them.
